newsitem.title: FRANCE: Paribas issues "buy" advice on Sidel.
newsitem.headline: Paribas issues "buy" advice on Sidel.

text.p: Paribas Capital Markets on Monday isued a "buy" recommendation on Sidel, upgrading it from "neutral", because it sees a significant rise in the orderbook and increased world demand for PET plastics.
Hubert de Marliave, analyst at Paribas, said the share of the company which is world leader in the production of machines for making PET bottles, could rise another 15 percent.
At 1251 GMT, Sidel was 1.89 percent higher at 339.80 francs.
There was also a block trade for one percent in Sidel's capital at 340 francs in the course of the morning.
